'''Rizos Flautply''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Carrick Station" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], stationed in the crisis command center within the [[rakghoul tunnels]] and was specializing as a supply officer for THORN volunteers affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He would later be stationed in the rakghoul tunnels on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

Captain Flautply was also stationed aboard the Republic's [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Carrick Station" />
